cards.back: to inherit (a title or throne passed down through the family)
cards.example: 启继承父位，开始了世袭王朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Qi inherited his father's position, starting a hereditary dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 世：一代又一代 · 袭：龙袍（衣）一代传给一代

cards.back: to inherit / succeed to
cards.example: 禹的儿子启继承了父位。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yu's son Qi inherited his father's position.
cards.breakdown: 继：丝线（纟）不断地接续下去 · 承：双手向上托住，接了下来

cards.back: dynasty (a ruling royal family)
cards.example: 夏是中国第一个世袭王朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Xia was China's first hereditary dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 王：一竖通着三横，连通天地人的君王 · 朝：太阳从草间升起，早晨拜见君王

cards.back: to enfeoff / grant land to nobles
cards.example: 周天子把土地分封给功臣。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Zhou king granted land to meritorious officials.
cards.breakdown: 分：用刀（刀）把东西分开（八） · 封：用手（寸）在土地（圭）上划界，赐给别人

cards.back: feudal lord / vassal (a nobleman given land by the king)
cards.example: 天子分封功臣，建立诸侯国。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Son of Heaven enfeoffed officials and set up vassal states.
cards.breakdown: 诸：许多（诸多）的意思 · 侯：受封（亻）掌管一方的贵族

cards.back: patriarchal clan system (rules based on family bloodline)
cards.example: 西周建立了宗法制。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Zhou established the patriarchal clan system.
cards.breakdown: 宗：屋顶（宀）下供着祖先牌位（示），一家之本 · 法：像水（氵）一样有规矩的制度

cards.back: legitimate (the main wife's son, of the proper line)
cards.example: 西周实行嫡长子继承权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Zhou practiced inheritance by the eldest legitimate son.
cards.breakdown: 嫡：正妻（女）生的、地位最正统的那一个

cards.back: bloodline / blood relationship (family by birth)
cards.example: 宗法制以血缘关系为基础。
cards.exampleTranslation: The patriarchal clan system was based on bloodline.
cards.breakdown: 血：盘子里盛着的一滴血 · 缘：丝线（纟）把一家人连在一起的关系

cards.back: the Son of Heaven (the king / emperor)
cards.example: 土地归周天子所有。
cards.exampleTranslation: The land belonged to the Zhou Son of Heaven.
cards.breakdown: 天：一个人（大）头顶上方就是天 · 子：孩子——天的儿子

cards.back: rank / level / hierarchy
cards.example: 宗法制是一种等级制度。
cards.exampleTranslation: The patriarchal clan system was a hierarchical system.
cards.breakdown: 等：竹简（竹）按官府（寺）的次序排列 · 级：丝线（纟）一段一段，有高有低

cards.back: meritorious official (a minister who did great service)
cards.example: 天子把土地分给亲属和功臣。
cards.exampleTranslation: The king gave land to relatives and meritorious officials.
cards.breakdown: 功：出力气（力）做工（工），立下功劳 · 臣：低头的眼睛，服从君主的官员

cards.back: generation after generation
cards.example: 封地可以世代享用。
cards.exampleTranslation: A fief could be enjoyed for generations.
cards.breakdown: 世：一代又一代 · 代：一个人（亻）替换（弋）另一个，一代接一代

cards.back: calendar (the system for counting days and years)
cards.example: 夏朝就有了历法。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Xia dynasty already had a calendar.
cards.breakdown: 历：一片片经历过的日子 · 法：像水（氵）一样有规矩的方法

cards.back: the lunar (farming) calendar
cards.example: 今天用的农历又叫'夏历'。
cards.exampleTranslation: The lunar calendar used today is also called the 'Xia calendar'.
cards.breakdown: 农：在田里劳动的农事 · 历：一段段经历过的日子

cards.back: writing / script / characters
cards.example: 甲骨文是刻在龟甲兽骨上的文字。
cards.exampleTranslation: Oracle bone script was writing carved on turtle shells and animal bones.
cards.breakdown: 文：像交错的花纹，最早的字 · 字：屋子（宀）里生出的孩子（子），文字不断孳生

cards.back: Chinese characters
cards.example: 今天的汉字是从甲骨文发展来的。
cards.exampleTranslation: Today's Chinese characters developed from oracle bone script.
cards.breakdown: 汉：汉水（氵）边的汉族 · 字：一个个方块文字

cards.back: to develop / evolve / grow
cards.example: 汉字从甲骨文一步步发展。
cards.exampleTranslation: Chinese characters developed step by step from oracle bone script.
cards.breakdown: 发：像箭一样射发出去 · 展：身体舒展开来，铺展开

cards.back: to record / write down
cards.example: 金文记录了许多西周的大事。
cards.exampleTranslation: Bronze inscriptions recorded many major events of the Western Zhou.
cards.breakdown: 记：用话（讠）把自己（己）记住 · 录：一笔一笔刻录下来

cards.back: to move / relocate / shift
cards.example: 周平王迁都洛阳，建立了东周。
cards.exampleTranslation: King Ping of Zhou moved the capital to Luoyang and founded the Eastern Zhou.
cards.breakdown: 迁：走（辶）到很远（千）的地方，搬家

cards.back: to fall / perish (a state or dynasty ends)
cards.example: 商朝最后被周打败灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Shang was finally defeated and fell to the Zhou.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了 · 亡：一个人躲进角落，藏起来不见了

cards.back: the Huaxia people – the ancestors of the Chinese nation
'descendants of Yan and Huang' – what Chinese people call themselves
the Yellow Emperor – legendary ancestor of the Chinese
the Yan Emperor – legendary ancestor who joined with the Yellow Emperor
Chi You – tribal leader defeated by Yan and Huang
oracle bone script – writing carved on turtle shells and animal bones
bronze inscriptions – characters cast onto bronze vessels
the Xia dynasty – China's first slave-owning state
the Shang dynasty – known for oracle bones and bronze casting
the Western Zhou – used the feudal and patriarchal clan systems
